verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents first-party background automation: continuous queries are SQL statements that run continuously on incoming data, load jobs and data transfers can be scheduled at regular intervals, and Dataform schedules complex transformation workflows in BigQuery. These are deterministic schedules and pipelines rather than AI-driven agentic automations, and the evidence is thin on how they are set up and managed. Missing for 10: AI/agent-driven autonomous tasks (e.g., Gemini acting on its own in the background), documented scheduled-query setup and monitoring depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
